topic: Practical on making entries in (specific A/C MOD Form 700C): For entering/removing limitation and husbandry defects in MOD Form 700C, Part 3
syllabus_extract: Practical on making entries in (specific A/C MOD Form 700C): For entering/removing limitation and husbandry defects in MOD Form 700C, Part 3 flight servicing log for BFS, TRS & AFS, Equipment log card for fitment / removal of equipment & inspections performed, Electrical / Avionics log book entries for scheduled inspection carried out, equipment. Fitment / removal and overhaul due time period, Equipment defect report INA-21 / MOD form 760, Equipment. Maintenance. Job card & Master job card for scheduled / unscheduled maintenance work carried out. & clearing of entries in U/S log MOD Form 700C.
specific_objectives: 21.1.2.1 Trainee will be able to explain basic documentation used in aircraft maintenance.

practical: Practical on making entries in specific A/C MOD Form 700C: Entering/removing limitation and husbandry defects, Flight servicing log entries, Equipment log card entries, Electrical/Avionics log book entries, Equipment defect report INA-21/MOD 760, Job card & Master job card entries, Clearing entries in U/S log MOD Form 700C. Safety: Handle forms carefully, verify data accuracy. Supervision: Instructor monitors entry accuracy and format compliance.
